items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Well, no. You don't get to know them more than you'd see them... everybody's glad to see Sedric and all them.

ctx.x: Oh, he was fabulous. So you didn't know him.

Well, no. You don't get to know them more than you'd see them. Like, you'd see Sissle. But you don't run up in Sissle's face. Not me.. Other people run up there and introduced theirselves. I know ...(?). . . "Oh, that's Sissle. He's (?) in the business." So you see him. There's Sissle. There's Claude Hopkins. You see Sam Wooding, and you understand he's coming back, and he came back to America, and everybody's glad to see Sedric and all them. But when they came back, nothin' happened.
